itens.trecho: O último grito. Dois anos após o segundo filme, durante a filmagem de um novo filme baseado na vida de Sidney (que vive sob outro nome), uma nova onda de assassinatos misteriosos agita a equipa do filmagens e todos suspeitam de um novo retorno do psicótico mascarado.

Scream 3’s lackluster screenplay and unimaginative kills leave a film that is a bore to watch. The meta-narrative of trilogies throughout the film does not make up for how abysmal the plot was. This film creates so much lore for the past movies seemingly out of the blue, muddling up the continuity for shock value.
Oh the irony of it all... After surviving the second wave of ghostface killings, Sidney Prescott has retired to the mountains to live in peace and work as a phone call therapist.
